gym.name: Devon Larratt Pronation Lift
preparation: Wrap the belt over your thumb.
Rest forearm on thigh or table.
Maintain a consistent back pressure angle.
tips: Do not let your wrist bend back.
This is the key move for the Top Roll.

gym.name: Rising with resistance band
preparation: Place band over your knuckles (not palm).
Keep your wrist perfectly straight or slightly ris.
execution: Lift your hand vertically using radial deviation.
Imagine lifting a hammer with just your wrist.
Hold for a second at the top.
tips: Target the very top of your forearm.
Do not use your bicep to lift.

gym.name: Rising with resistance band 2
preparation: Focus on a higher anchor point for the band.
tips: Keep your knuckles the highest point.

gym.name: Pronation curls
preparation: Start with palm facing slightly up/neutral.
execution: Curl and rotate thumb down simultaneously.

gym.name: Rising curls with resistance band
preparation: Start in extended hammer curl position.
execution: Curl while driving knuckles to the ceiling.
Keep the thumb side of hand high.
tips: Combines riser strength with bicep power.
